title: The Elle and Emmett Couples Costume
intro: The couples costume where she does the heavy lifting and he just has to own a corduroy blazer. A hot pink mini, pink slingbacks and a quilted pink bag for her, the brown blazer for him, and you both know who ends up wearing it by the end of the night.

sections.heading: She does the costume, he brings the blazer
paragraphs: Here is how this couples costume works in real life. One of you commits. The other one owns a brown corduroy blazer and shows up. That's it. In the flat lay you can see the whole thing on the floorboards, the hot pink mini sitting under the blazer like it already knows how the night ends, with the bow, the bag and the slingbacks circled around it.

The dress is a square neck fit and flare, so it nips in at the waist and then swings out. That shape is the whole Elle look, and it is forgiving if you ate a lot of candy corn that afternoon. Check the size chart on the listing before you order, because fitted bodices run differently, and go by your bust and waist measurements, not the size you usually grab.

His half is easy. The men's corduroy blazer goes over whatever he already has, a white tee or a button down and jeans. If he owns a brown blazer already, perfect, you just saved yourself a whole item. If not, order his usual jacket size and have him try it on over a sweater, because you will be stealing it later.

sections.heading: Pink head to toe, on purpose
paragraphs: The kitten heel slingbacks are the smartest call in this outfit. Pointed toe, low heel, hot pink. You get the polished look without walking around a party on stilts. In the porch photo I'm standing on concrete steps in them, and that is the most heel I want on a night that involves a porch, a yard and probably a hayride somebody insists on.

The quilted crossbody with the gold chain holds your phone, a lip color and a card, and nothing else, which is honestly good discipline. Wear it crossbody like I did so your hands stay free for a drink. The heart charm huggies are small, so they won't fight with the bow, and they are light enough to wear all night without that earlobe ache.

sections.heading: The bow and the hair do the talking
paragraphs: The satin hair bow clip is the piece people clock first, before you even turn around. I clipped it at the back of a half up style with loose curls, and you can see it peeking out in the porch photo. Big curls, half up, bow. If your hair is short, clip it at the side above your ear instead and call it done.

Makeup is pink and glossy and not complicated. Rosy blush, a pink lip, a little shimmer on the lids. Paint your nails pink too if you have twenty minutes, because you will be holding a cup all night and people notice hands in photos. The roses, the heart sunglasses, the notebook, the iced coffee and the pumpkins in the flat lay are styling extras, not part of the list.

sections.heading: Who ends up wearing the blazer
paragraphs: Every October night starts warm and ends cold, and that mini dress has no sleeves. By the time the party moved outside I had his blazer over my shoulders, which is exactly how it looks in the porch shot, jack-o-lanterns on the steps and all. He did not complain. He also did not get it back until we were home.

Budget wise, start with your closet. A pink dress you already own, any brown blazer, any pink shoes you can stand in for hours. Then buy only the pieces that make the look read as this couple, which for most people is the bow and the bag. The dress works again for a birthday dinner, and the blazer goes straight into his fall rotation.
